dedupe_keys.name: swiss public building construction cost benchmark database

description: The kennwerte-db repository publishes a Swiss public-building construction cost database and its extraction pipeline. Its own data-model document describes 373 project rows in the SQLite database, with gross floor area, building volume, completion year, total construction cost and selected BKP or eBKP-H cost breakdowns. Source documents come from federal, cantonal and municipal building authorities, including BBL, armasuisse and Zurich. The project calls itself an unofficial research prototype and warns that extracted values may be incomplete or wrong. The source inventory distinguishes documents already in its pipeline from potential future sources, so its full source list is not a claim of loaded database coverage. The repository is MIT licensed, while source documents and third-party tools retain their own terms. The public tree lists the SQLite database; this review did not open its rows or verify the reported 373-row count. Simulation use includes rough building-replacement cost calibration and portfolio investment scenarios, after checking each estimate against its original document and price year. It complements data-us-census-building-permits-survey with realised Swiss construction costs, not permit counts.
